entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Seede a mi e, wo Roog, wo bindaxam ndax um andoñ soo bugoñ.
Mixe seede a ndik, o ñak o waages, fo waag'of, o ñakes fo jeg'of.
Roog fa leñ jeegee faa refeerna wo, wo ñufiga we ndefna na sabab, oxaa na ñoowaa o ñoon xooxum.
